facts.business: East West Freight Carriers Limited operates as an integrated logistics service provider utilizing an asset-light model, offering air freight forwarding, ocean freight forwarding (FCL & LCL), customs brokerage, specialized pharma & cold-chain logistics, project cargo & heavy lift handling, multi-modal road & rail logistics, and smart warehousing & express cargo consolidation.
key_risks: Freight Tariff and Fuel Price Volatility
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions disclosed with Holding Company (East West Holding Limited), Subsidiary (Zip Express & Logistic Private Limited), Associates (Tandem Global Logistics (India) Pvt Ltd 20%, Mectech Exim Pvt Ltd 20%), and other related parties including Marshal Mfg & Exports, Landmark Envirocare LLP, Cardinal Customs Brokers & Forwarders LLP, Unique Air Freight Express and Logistics Private Limited, and Key Managerial Personnel. Transaction limits approved for FY 2026-27: Marshal Mfg. & Export Rs. 16 Crore, Tandem Global Logistics (India) Pvt Ltd Rs. 5 Crore, Cardinal Customs Broker & Forwards LLP Rs. 5 Crore, Landmark Enviro-care LLP Rs. 1 Crore, Unique Air Freight Express & Logistics Pvt Ltd Rs. 4 Crore.
